name: IC 4041 (Webb)
blurb: IC 4041, a galaxy in the Coma Cluster, seen by Webb.
label: ic4041-webb
story: A galaxy of the Coma Cluster, the nearest rich cluster of galaxies. Webb measured the surface brightness fluctuations of its starlight, part of an effort to pin down how fast the universe expands.

claims.text: IC 4041 is one of the large galaxies in the Coma Cluster targeted by Webb program 5989
The Coma Cluster is the nearest rich cluster and a key touchstone for the distance scale
Webb measured surface brightness fluctuations (SBF) to build a distance ladder aimed at the Hubble constant
IC 4041 is classified as type SA0 in a study of early-type galaxies in the Coma cluster
The Coma Cluster is one of the nearest rich clusters
